tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List every product in the Nord Trail catalog with slug, SKU, price and URL.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: UCP 2026-04-08 catalog search. Free-text query over the catalog; returns UCP product objects in structuredContent. Call with no query to list everything.

tools.name: lookup_catalog
tools.description: UCP 2026-04-08 catalog lookup: resolve one or more product or variant identifiers (slug or SKU) to UCP product objects.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One product: the UCP product object in structuredContent, and the schema.org Product JSON-LD the product page publishes as text.

tools.name: check_stock
tools.description: Live stock and price for a SKU.

tools.name: report_problem
tools.description: Tell this store that something stopped you from completing a task: a product you could not price, a variant you could not find, a request that was refused. Read by a human. Use it instead of giving up silently — a store only learns that an agent failed if the agent says so.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "report_problem" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Tell this store that something stopped you from completing a task: a product you could not price, a variant you could not find, a request that was refused. Read…
